title: clozn ci check report
description: The report `clozn ci check` prints (--json) and writes (--report FILE), assembled by clozn.cli.commands.ci_check.run_gate (mode='baseline') or gate_experiment_result (mode='experiment') and finished by cmd_ci_check (which adds exit_code and the *_path/model fields). This schema covers only the pass/fail report clozn ci check actually writes to disk: an identity-policy refusal (exit 3) writes a separate, much smaller {refused, reason} object before any check runs, and an execution error (exit 2, e.g. an unreadable/invalid input file) never reaches a --report write at all -- neither is described here, on purpose, rather than forcing them into a shape they don't have.

check_result.description: One budget check's outcome, as produced by ci_check.py's _check_golden/_check_tiny/_check_diff (mode=baseline) or gate_experiment_result's per-budget checks (mode=experiment). Only 'passed' is required -- 'ran', 'budget', 'observed', and 'worst_offenders' are present on every check kind clozn ships today, but a future check kind may honestly omit one (e.g. a check with no natural 'budget' concept) rather than null-pad it.

mode.description: 'baseline': clozn ci check --baseline FILE MODEL (checks are golden/tiny/diff; identity/identity_policy/live_identity are present). 'experiment': clozn ci check --experiment RESULT.json (checks are artifact_integrity/execution_errors/target_regressions/guard_regressions/target_gains; artifact is present).

exit_code.description: 0 == overall pass, 1 == overall fail. Exit codes 2 (execution error) and 3 (identity refusal) never produce a document validated against this schema -- see the top-level description.

checks.description: Keyed by check name (golden/tiny/diff for mode=baseline; artifact_integrity/execution_errors/target_regressions/guard_regressions/target_gains for mode=experiment). Only enabled/applicable checks appear -- an empty object is valid (and, per ci_check.py's own contract, gates the report to overall=fail: a gate that checks nothing is a misconfiguration, not a clean pass).

identity.description: mode=baseline only: clozn.runs.identity.runtime_identity() of the model under test.

identity_policy.description: mode=baseline only: pin_model policy verdict, see ci_check.identity_policy_check.

live_identity.description: mode=baseline only: whether the model that actually answered probes matches the identity this report certifies, see ci_check.live_identity_verdict.

artifact.description: mode=experiment only: identifying fields lifted from the gated clozn.experiment.result.v0 artifact.

model.description: mode=baseline only: the resolved absolute model path.
